summary: P01 V2.47.238 matures the Software & Setup landing header. The body-level duplicate software search is removed; the shared Subsite Masthead search becomes the single Local Search authority with a Software-specific placeholder, while q-driven one-page filtering is preserved through the existing initial-query payload. The obsolete tall hero minimum height is removed, title/description spacing is tightened, install-plan controls are reorganized into a compact recovery workbar, and platform/purpose filters are simplified into one quiet bounded control surface. Software remains a Start-derived presentation with unchanged canonical data/mutation semantics. No Schema/Migration, auth/session/security, updater mechanism, provider/server or Production write change. Production remains Owner-manual.
